choices: A way to create multiple JFrames from different threads
A background thread that can safely update Swing components when done
A faster alternative to the Event Dispatch Thread
A thread pool for handling multiple button clicks simultaneously
explanation: SwingWorker<T,V> executes work in background via doInBackground(), then updates the UI in done() which runs on the EDT. process(List<V> chunks) is called on the EDT for intermediate results. Ideal for long-running tasks like network calls triggered by a button.
